CREATIVE ARTS — TERMLY EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The speed of the music
   D. The ticket price

2. Best practice when working on Percussion Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Percussion Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Percussion Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Percussion Musical Instruments.
   D. Damage equipment used for Percussion Musical Instruments.

3. Best practice when working on Photography: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Photography.
   B. Practise Photography with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Photography.
   D. Damage equipment used for Photography.

4. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

5. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Netball.
   C. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Netball.

6. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Songs.

7. Best practice when working on Painting and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Painting and Montage.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Painting and Montage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Painting and Montage.
   D. Practise Painting and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Descant Recorder.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Descant Recorder.
   C. Damage equipment used for Descant Recorder.
   D. Practise Descant Recorder with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

9. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Black, white, and grey
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Brown, pink, and gold
   D. Green, orange, and purple

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Games.
   C. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Games.

12. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Remove the need for rules
   D. Guarantee a trophy

13. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   C. Damage equipment used for Swimming.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.

14. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

15. Best practice when working on Gymnastics: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Gymnastics.
   B. Damage equipment used for Gymnastics.
   C. Practise Gymnastics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Gymnastics.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Painting and Montage and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Athletics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Gymnastics and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
